The server is live and running. Here's a summary of everything built:

---

**Built:** `baires-chronicle` — a complete minimalist photo-journalism block theme for Diego Fernández, based in Buenos Aires.

**Theme structure (18 files):**
- `theme.json` — editorial palette (ink/paper/accent gold), Playfair Display + Inter typography, constrained 840px layout
- `style.css` — global polish (header border, nav uppercase, post grid)
- `functions.php` — Google Fonts enqueue via `enqueue_block_assets`
- `templates/` — `front-page.html`, `home.html`, `page.html`, `single.html`, `index.html`
- `parts/` — `header.html` (site title + nav), `footer.html` (dark ink + nav)
- `patterns/` — `hero.php` (full-bleed 90vh cover), `featured-work.php` (3-column dark grid), `about-teaser.php` (portrait + bio columns)
- `assets/` — 5 solid-color AI_IMAGE placeholder PNGs (ready for `generate --files` later)

**Both gates passed:** `validate-blocks.cjs` (all NORMALIZE auto-fixed) + `editor-gate.mjs` → **GATE PASS (10 items)**

**Content:** Static home → `front-page.html`; `/journal/` (posts page) → `home.html` query loop with 11 photojournalism stories; `/about/` → Diego Fernández biography.

**Live site:** http://127.0.0.1:9402/
